title: golden session 6: the adoption play (adolion-saga, Artemis)
objective: v2.8 70 D8 golden session GS6. One adolion-fresh lane at the bumped campaign pin with Artemis v1.1, shipped defaults: thinking and inner voice on, judge on TypeSafe, authoring on Sol, images and sprites off. The carrier is adolion-saga in its own group, picked by id because it is the one adopted story holding every world-layer feature; every feature is found by structure at run time, and where 12 turns cannot reach a gate the check uses the shortest author write and records which path it took. Player lines are generic and name nothing from the campaign; eval results are counts only. 12 real player turns. Run twice back to back on one lane, run 2 from the seeded snapshot. A no-model lane runs the plumbing only (GS6.8 fails there by construction).

checks.goal: Lane guard, start and structure census. Closes: stories (the adopted carrier starts, picked by id, features found by structure). Fails before any turn when the pinned carrier lacks adopted data (codex facts behind a reached gate, a secret label, factions with moves, a clock, public checks with when, rumors, recap quests, narrated public qualities with an omniscient narrator, a scene widget, scene_test). Two real turns.
